_doc: Per-brief size bounds read by gz validate --brief-size (GHI #1196). A live OBPI brief whose measured value exceeds `max` on any dimension fails closed. Authority for the rule: docs/governance/GovZero/obpi-decomposition-matrix.md (Refining Overlay). The numbers are the 95th percentile of the terminal brief corpus, the block percentile .gzkit/rules/complexity-thresholds.json uses; re-derive them, do not hand-tune them.

derivation.method: linear-interpolated percentile of measure_brief() over the population, floored to an integer
derivation.ratified: operator ruling 2026-10-13, verbatim: "ratify the bounds and ceilings, land it"
